    StartersLondon pub scotch eggsSoft-boiled eggs wrapped in sage sausage meat and breadcrumbs, fried, with English mustardHow to make it4 eggs400g pork sausage mince1 tbsp chopped sage1/2 cup plain flour1 egg, beaten1 cup panko breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil3 tbsp English mustardBoil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.Mix the sausage mince with the sage and wrap around each egg.Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko.Fry in the vegetable oil at 170°C for 6 minutes, then halve and serve with mustard.Greenwich tube stop chipsTwice-fried chips with malt vinegar. Thor took the Tube here.How to make it1kg potatoes, cut into thick chips1 L vegetable oil4 tbsp malt vinegar2 tsp sea salt flakesRinse the cut potatoes and dry well.Fry the chips in the vegetable oil at 140°C for 6 minutes until soft, then drain and rest.Fry again at 190°C until golden and crisp.Tip into paper, shake over malt vinegar and plenty of sea salt.Jane's date night tomato bruschettaTomato bruschetta. Jane hid behind a three-choice menu.How to make itAs written, serves 4Grilled ciabatta rubbed with garlic, piled with ripe tomato and basil, torn buffalo mozzarella, sea salt and a drizzle of good olive oil.Dice 500g ripe tomatoes and mix with a handful of torn basil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt, and leave 15 minutes.Slice 1 ciabatta into 12 pieces, brush with olive oil and grill or toast until charred at the edges.Rub each with a cut garlic clove.Pile on the tomato, tear over 2 balls of buffalo mozzarella and finish with sea salt and more oil.MainsLondon pie and mashBeef braised in brown ale under puff pastry, with buttery mashed potatoesHow to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 brown onions, sliced375ml brown ale2 sheets of puff pastry1kg potatoes50g butter100ml milk500g frozen peas1 tbsp plain flour2 tbsp oilBrown the beef in the oil with the onions, then stir in the flour.Add the brown ale and water to cover and simmer until tender.Pour into a dish and top with puff pastry. Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk. Cook the peas and serve everything together.Asgard honey and rosemary lamb shoulderHoney and rosemary lamb. A toast to Frigga.How to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and honey, slow roasted until it pulls apart, with roasted root vegetables and the pan juices.Stab a 2kg lamb shoulder all over and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs.Rub with 3 tbsp honey, olive oil and salt.Put in a roasting dish with 250ml water, cover with foil and roast at 150°C for 5 hours.Add 1kg chopped carrots, parsnips and potatoes for the last 90 minutes, uncovering for the final 30.Pull the lamb apart and spoon over the juices.SweetsDark Elves blackberry tartVanilla custard tart piled with blackberries and glazed with jamHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry500ml thick vanilla custard250g blackberries3 tbsp blackberry jam1 tbsp icing sugarBlind bake the pastry case at 180°C until golden and cool completely.Fill with the custard and pile the blackberries on top.Warm the jam with a splash of water and brush over the fruit to glaze.Chill, then dust the edge with icing sugar.DrinksAether blood orange and cranberry spritzVodka, blood orange, cranberry and lime with soda. Red as the Aether.How to make it120ml vodka240ml blood orange juice240ml cranberry juice40ml lime juice240ml soda water1 blood orange, sliced4 rosemary sprigs1 bag iceShake the vodka, juices and lime juice hard with ice, in batches.Strain into wine glasses full of ice and top with soda water.Garnish with a blood orange wheel and a rosemary sprig. Leave out the vodka for a booze-free version.
